title: Having this makes your LinkedIn profile 11x MORE likely to be viewed 🔎
description:
Did you know having a LinkedIn banner makes your profile 11 times more likely to be viewed? It's one of the easiest things to add to there's no reason not to have one. LinkedIn has several built-in options but you could also use royalty free stock photo websites or Canva if you wanted to make your own. #linkedin #linkedinprofile #linkedintips #linkedinprofiletips
